title: Can I BEAT Soko Chess?
summary: Soko Chess (Steam): a minimalist Sokoban-style chess puzzle game. You control white piece(s) (rook first, later bishop etc.) and must PUSH black pawns onto marked destination squares (red pawn icons) instead of capturing. Black pawns still capture diagonally, so you must avoid stepping into their attack. Undo (Y/Z) and restart (R/B) available. Tony clears levels 1-10 ('Humble Beginning' first) and peeks at 11.
rules: Puzzle levels, no opponent AI: move your white piece(s) with normal chess movement.
Moving into a black pawn pushes it one square in the movement direction; goal: push every black pawn onto a destination marker.
Black pawns capture diagonally (one square) after your move if you land in their attack; being captured fails the level.
Later levels add bishops and sacrificial tactics (pawn takes back).
win_condition: Push all black pawns onto their destination squares (complete the level).
